meta.name: frontend
meta.description: MUST USE for frontend/web UI/UX/visual work: building, styling, redesigning pages/components, React setup, performance audits, visual QA, taste, and polish. Routes four rulesets: design taste router and brand references; perfection for Playwright/Chromium Lighthouse/Core Web Vitals; ui-ux-db palettes/fonts/guidelines; designpowers personas/accessibility/critique/handoff; plus curl-only lazyweb real-app-screen research and the beui.dev interaction catalog. Triggers: frontend, UI, UX, design, redesign, styling, layout, animation, motion, interaction, micro-interaction, make it feel alive, premium, luxury, minimal, brutalist, Awwwards, DESIGN.md, mockup, React, Lighthouse, accessibility, WCAG, Core Web Vitals, looks generic, make it pretty, like X brand, lazyweb, design research.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计优质前端界面，整合品牌与性能标准
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要构建美观且高性能的前端界面
copy.tagline_en: Design high-quality frontend UI with brand and performance standards
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to build beautiful and high-performance frontend UI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 处理前端/UI 工作时会先按请求加载相应的设计规则和品牌参考，强制建立 DESIGN.md 设计系统，再依此实现页面或组件；它还要求用真实浏览器跑 Lighthouse 审计并做视觉 QA。
howto.when: 当用户提到前端、UI、设计等关键词，或要求做页面构建、性能审计、视觉 QA 时触发。

say.text: 帮我设计一个登录页，按 Stripe 的风格来。
say.note: 会加载 Stripe 品牌参考并生成 DESIGN.md。

say.text: 这个页面太丑了，重新设计一下，让它更精致。
say.note: 会先审计现有 UI 再出手改进。

say.text: 对 React 应用做性能审计，跑 Lighthouse 并修到满分。
say.note: 会用真实浏览器测量并修复性能问题。

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude routes frontend/UI requests to relevant rulesets, enforces a DESIGN.md design system, implements from it, audits with real-browser Lighthouse, and performs visual QA.
howto.when_en: Activates when the user mentions keywords like frontend, UI, design, or asks for page building, performance audits, visual QA.

say_en.text: Design a login page in Stripe's style.
say_en.note: Loads Stripe brand reference and generates DESIGN.md.

say_en.text: This page looks bad, redesign it to be more polished.
Audit the React app's performance with Lighthouse and fix to 100.
say_en.note: Runs real-browser audit and gives fixes.
